 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay

 Versus

 .........
 Mr. Shreeram Shirsat for the Petitioners.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram : Prakash D. Naik &
 N.R. Borkar, Jj.

Dated : 14th December 2023
 P.C. :-
 . The Petitioners are challenging the charge-sheet arising out
of First Information Report dated 30th September 2022 (Fir) registered with Cbd Belapur Police
Station for the offences under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 427 r/w. 34 of Indian Penal Code (Ipc)
vide Crime No.156 of 2022.
2. The Petitioners are mother-in-law and father-in-law of Respondent No.2.
The marriage between accused No.1 and Respondent No.2 was performed on 17 th October 2018.
Legal notice through Advocate was sent at the instance of Respondent No.2 on 15 th December 2021 which does not attribute any overt act or allegations of harassment to the Petitioners.
However, subsequently the FIR was lodged on 30 th September 2022 which contains certain allegations.
3. Issue notice to Respondent No.2, returnable on 22 nd January 2024.
Proceedings before the trial Court are stayed till next date.

( N.R. BORKAR, J. ) ( PRAKASH D. NAIK, J. )
